## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, ...) — checked by CI
- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .` reports no changes
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes with no issues
- [ ] `flutter test` passes
- [ ] New/changed behavior has test coverage where practical
- [ ] Relevant docs in [`docs/`](../docs) or `README.md` are updated
